# react

## Type Aliases

### AppMountState

```ts
type AppMountState = Readonly<
  | {
      app: AppRoot;
      status: "live";
    }
  | {
      app: null;
      status: "connecting" | "standalone" | "ended";
    }
>;
```

The App connection state passed to `mountApp`'s `render` callback: `live` once
connected, or `connecting`/`standalone`/`ended` while there is no usable App.

### useWindowStatus()

```ts
function useWindowStatus(app, items, onAction?, onReportFailure?): void;
```

Keep this window's status bar items current in the host while mounted, and hear
the person use them. Items compare by value; the bar clears on unmount.

#### Parameters

| Parameter          | Type                                                                     | Description                                            |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `app`              | `Pick`\<[`AppRoot`](index.md#approot), `"ui"`\> \| `null` \| `undefined` | -                                                      |
| `items`            | readonly [`AppStatusItem`](index.md#appstatusitem)[]                     | -                                                      |
| `onAction?`        | [`AppStatusActionHandler`](index.md#appstatusactionhandler)              | -                                                      |
| `onReportFailure?` | (`cause`) => `void`                                                      | Hear a report the host refused, so the App can say so. |

#### Returns

`void`

### useHostNavigation()

```ts
function useHostNavigation(navigation, __namedParameters): void;
```

Publish an App's navigation state to its host and own the host's Back requests
while mounted. Pass `app?.window.navigation`; with no connected App it does
nothing. Unmounting withdraws Back from the host chrome.

#### Parameters

| Parameter           | Type                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `navigation`        | \| `Readonly`\<\{ `publish`: `Promise`\<`void`\>; `onBack`: [`Disposer`](index.md#disposer); \}\> \| `null` \| `undefined` |
| `__namedParameters` | [`HostNavigationOptions`](#hostnavigationoptions)                                                                          |

#### Returns

`void`
